name: The Tree of Life
description: A world of its own, growing quietly on your wall. Peacocks, flowering branches, and a thousand little details come together in this richly layered, Mithila-inspired celebration of life.
story: The tree of life is a recurring symbol in Mithila painting, connecting the everyday with the sacred. In this contemporary digital interpretation, paired peacocks stand for harmony, while the flowering canopy celebrates renewal and belonging.

reviews.name: Ananya S.
reviews.title: The little details are everything
reviews.text: Printed it on textured matte paper and it looks so lovely above my reading chair. The green is beautifully rich.

reviews.name: Rohan M.
reviews.title: A little reminder of home
reviews.text: The download was straightforward and the print guide helped me choose paper. Such a warm addition to my space.

reviews.name: Emily C.
reviews.title: A beautiful focal point
reviews.text: I love discovering new art traditions. The birds and tiny leaves make me notice something different every day.

reviews.name: Mira K.
reviews.title: Lovely colors
reviews.text: Beautiful on cream paper. I would recommend a test print first to get your printer settings just right.

name: The Peacock Pair
description: Two peacocks, an unspoken conversation. An intricate dance of indigo feathers, curling vines, and warm ochre brings the graceful symmetry of Mithila to a quiet corner of your home.
story: Peacocks are a beloved motif in the visual traditions of the Mithila region of Nepal and India. This AI-assisted digital composition draws on the double-line patterns and nature-inspired storytelling associated with Madhubani painting.

reviews.name: Priya N.
reviews.title: Perfect pair for our home
reviews.text: The blue is gorgeous. I printed it at a local shop in the included 8 by 10 size and found a simple oak frame.

reviews.name: James L.
reviews.title: So much character
reviews.text: The intricate feather patterns are really special. Easy download and clear file names.

reviews.name: Sneha P.
reviews.title: Quietly beautiful
reviews.text: The earthy blue works so well with the other colors in my bedroom. Very happy with this piece.

name: Surya, the Eternal Sun
description: Let a little light in. A radiant terracotta sun, surrounded by rhythmic petals and fine geometric lines, makes an uplifting companion for your everyday rituals.
story: Surya, the sun, appears throughout South Asian visual culture as a symbol of light and vitality. This contemporary digital work takes inspiration from the circular forms and detailed borders seen in Mithila painting.

reviews.name: Aditi R.
reviews.title: A happy little sun
reviews.text: This brings such warmth to my entryway. I used the smaller PDF and it printed perfectly.

reviews.name: Oliver B.
reviews.title: Beautiful warm tones
reviews.text: Really like the aged paper feel and the detail in the border. The print guide is a thoughtful extra.

reviews.name: Nisha T.
reviews.title: Lovely for a gallery wall
reviews.text: The terracotta tone looks slightly different on my printer, but a local print shop got it just right.

name: The Lotus Pond
description: A moment of stillness, captured in bloom. Pale lotus flowers, quiet egrets, and deep forest greens invite a sense of calm into rooms that need a little breathing space.
story: Inspired by the lotus-filled settings of Pichwai painting, this digital botanical composition celebrates the beauty of quiet, repeated forms. It is a contemporary interpretation, not a reproduction of a historical painting.

reviews.name: Hannah W.
reviews.title: Just the calm I wanted
reviews.text: The green and soft pink feel wonderfully calm together. Looks beautiful in a vintage frame.

reviews.name: Kavya D.
reviews.title: Love the lotus flowers
reviews.text: I put this above my desk and it makes the whole corner feel more considered. Downloading was easy.

reviews.name: Sofia A.
reviews.title: A lovely find
reviews.text: The artwork has a beautiful paper texture. I chose a small print and the details came out nicely.

name: The Circle of Joy
description: Life, in its simplest lines. A spirited circle of dancing figures brings rhythm, movement, and the warmth of terracotta to a home that tells its own stories.
story: The visual language of Warli painting uses simple geometric forms to tell stories of community and the natural world. This contemporary digital piece takes inspiration from the tarpa dance, a recurring communal motif.

reviews.name: Arjun V.
reviews.title: Full of movement
reviews.text: The simplicity is what makes this work. It feels lively without overwhelming our small dining room.

reviews.name: Chloe F.
reviews.title: Warm and graphic
reviews.text: A beautiful terracotta color. The A4 file was exactly what I needed for a frame I already owned.

reviews.name: Dev S.
reviews.title: A lovely everyday piece
reviews.text: Simple, cheerful, and easy to print. I prefer it on lightly textured paper rather than glossy.

name: The Sacred Bloom
description: A quiet kind of wonder. Layered lotus petals and delicate indigo lines unfold into a mandala that feels both ancient and wonderfully at home in the present.
story: Lotus forms and radial geometry have a long history in South Asian art and architecture. This original digital interpretation explores balance and repetition without representing a specific historical or ritual object.

reviews.name: Lina H.
reviews.title: Beautifully balanced
reviews.text: The fine lines and muted palette work so well in our hallway. Printed the smaller size and it looks lovely.

reviews.name: Meera J.
reviews.title: A thoughtful addition
reviews.text: I wanted something gentle for my meditation corner. This is just right, and the files are clearly organized.

reviews.name: Sam R.
reviews.title: Details worth looking at
reviews.text: So much delicate pattern to enjoy. The included print instructions made the process very simple.

name: The Earth & Sky Pair
description: Better, together. Our Tree of Life and Peacock Pair bring the warmth of the earth and the quiet depth of indigo into one harmonious, thoughtfully paired set.
story: Two distinct palettes, one shared language. These Mithila-inspired digital artworks are designed to sit comfortably together, whether side by side above a console or bringing two corners of your home into conversation.

reviews.name: Tara B.
reviews.title: A perfect pairing
reviews.text: I wasn't sure how to pair prints, so this set made it easy. They look wonderful together in matching frames.

reviews.name: Akash G.
reviews.title: Made the room feel finished
reviews.text: Two simple oak frames and these prints made such a difference to our living room. Really lovely colors.

name: The Heritage Collection
description: Six stories. Endless ways to make them yours. Our complete heritage edit brings together nature, folk rhythms, celestial forms, and sacred geometry for a home full of character.
story: A gentle introduction to the gallery, thoughtfully collected. Explore six contemporary digital interpretations inspired by Mithila, Pichwai, Warli, and the timeless geometry of the lotus.

reviews.name: Elena P.
reviews.title: So many beautiful options
reviews.text: I love being able to change the artwork around with the seasons. Each file is labeled and easy to find.

reviews.name: Shreya L.
reviews.title: A thoughtfully curated set
reviews.text: We made a small gallery wall using three pieces and put the others in our bedrooms. Such a cohesive collection.
